description: Composes instructions for authoring a brand-new, custom design system as a DESIGN.md file plus a sibling tokens.css following the Open Design token contract. Writes no DESIGN.md or tokens.css; with kind it writes the system's brand.json (own brand or reference, descriptor, and from evidenceDir the source URLs and the site screenshot as reference.png), which the recommender, the check and the critic read. If sourceUrl is given, performs a best-effort extraction of candidate colors/fonts from that page. After writing the files, call set_active_design_system with the returned id. To write ONLY a tokens.css for an existing custom design system (id starting with user:), pass existingDesignSystemId instead of name/brief.

brief.description: A description of the brand, in the user's own words. Required unless existingDesignSystemId is given.

descriptor.description: Optional, with kind: what the recommender matches on, as for bundled systems.

industries.description: e.g. fintech, saas, retail, food, health, education, dating

moods.description: e.g. calm, playful, premium, technical, bold, minimal, warm, romantic

evidenceDir.description: Optional, with kind: the bundleDir extract_open_design_design_system returned. Records the source URLs, keeps the site screenshot as reference.png, writes review.html, and puts the brand kit into brand.json: marks (copied into assets/ for an own brand only), fonts with their source, component specs, voice facts (and, for an own brand, the sampled lines) and imagery.

existingDesignSystemId.description: Optional: the id of an existing custom design system (user:…). Returns instructions to write only its tokens.css, from its current DESIGN.md.

fontLicence.description: Optional, with kind own and evidenceDir: 'confirmed' when the user says they hold the licence for the brand's self-hosted fonts. Only then are the font files the site loaded copied into the design system's assets/fonts/. Never for a reference site.

kind.description: Optional: own when this is the user's own brand (DESIGN.md is headed '<Name> Design System', the recommender puts it first, and the check and critic hold designs to it); reference for a look taken from someone else's site ('Design System Inspired by <Name>'). Writes brand.json.

name.description: A short name for the design system. Required unless existingDesignSystemId is given.

sourceUrl.description: Optional: a website URL to take a rough starting palette and fonts from, by reading its source. For a design system that matches a site, call extract_open_design_design_system first instead: it renders the page and measures it.

name: create_open_design_design_system
title: Create a design system
